fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A bite that deals 22 damage, leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Split Moult
fusions.desc: Bursts your outgrown shell, which deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spun Mail
fusions.desc: Wraps you in layered silk that absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 6%.

fusions.name: Bound Hands Hit Soft
fusions.desc: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.
